label: Hotel Check-In
description: Arrive at hotel. Assist with check-in. Guide briefs for next-day activities. Evening free.

label: Airport Drop-Off
description: Transfer to Juanda International Airport (SUB). Drop-off at departure terminal. Tour ends.

label: Train Station Drop-Off
description: Transfer to Surabaya Gubeng or Malang Kotabaru station. Tour ends upon arrival at station.

label: Return to Hotel
description: Return to accommodation after day activity. Evening at leisure.

label: Free Afternoon
description: Arrive back at hotel after morning activities. Afternoon free for personal exploration or rest.

label: Dinner at Restaurant
description: Transfer to local restaurant for dinner. Return to hotel after dinner.

label: Overnight at Bromo
description: Settle at Bromo area accommodation. Briefing for 03:00 AM sunrise call. Early sleep recommended.

label: Overnight at Banyuwangi/Bondowoso
description: Arrive at Ijen-area hotel/villa. Check-in. Set alarm for midnight departure to Ijen. Gear preparation.

label: Continue to Malang
description: Depart from current destination. Drive to Malang (~2–4 hours depending on origin). Check-in at Malang hotel.

label: Continue to Surabaya
description: Depart from current destination. Drive to Surabaya (~2–4 hours). Check-in at Surabaya hotel or airport transfer.

label: Continue to Bondowoso
description: Depart from Bromo area. Drive ~2.5 hours to Bondowoso. Check-in for Ijen preparation night.

label: Continue to Banyuwangi
description: Depart from Bondowoso or Jember. Drive ~2 hours to Banyuwangi. Check-in at Ijen-access hotel.

label: Continue to Jember
description: Arrive in Jember. Check-in at Jember hotel. Rest before Papuma or Tumpak Sewu next day.

label: Bali Ferry Transfer
description: Drive to Ketapang port, Banyuwangi. Board ferry to Gilimanuk, Bali. Continue by land to Bali destination.
